newsitem.title: GREECE: BARCLAYS LAUNCHES INCOME, MONEY MARKET MUTUAL FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: BARCLAYS LAUNCHES INCOME, MONEY MARKET MUTUAL FUNDS.

text.p: Barclays Bank started the distribution of shares in its recently launched fixed income and money market mutual funds at an initial net price of 2,000 drachmas on Monday, it said in a statement.

Its fixed income fund will invest in medium-and-long term state securities with the money market fund opting for money market instruments. Each mutual fund is starting with assets of 400 million drachmas, it said.

"Our plans call for additional investment products down the line besides the two initial funds. The particular type will also depend on market conditions," Spyros Creticopoulos, general manager of Barclays Mutual Fund Management told Reuters.

Barclays Mutual Fund Management, a fully owned subsidiary of Barclays, will be the exclusive distributor of the mutual fund shares along with the bank's branch network. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
